# Bit2Me API

> Developer documentation for the Bit2Me gateway REST API, Pro Trading, partner onboarding, WebSockets, and MCP.

Server: https://gateway.bit2me.com
Current Scalar reference (parallel): https://api.bit2me.com/doc
Status: https://status.bit2me.com
Support: https://support.bit2me.com
Tickets: https://support.bit2me.com/en/support/tickets/new
API keys: https://account.bit2me.com/api-keys
MCP: https://mcp.bit2me.com
OpenAPI snapshots in this repo: openapi/crypto.json, openapi/trading-spot-rest.json, openapi/embed.json

Do not invent endpoints, SLAs, sunset dates, or Travel Rule thresholds. HMAC cannot be computed in the Mintlify playground. Nonce is Unix time in milliseconds.
